context_requirements: Functional SREBP processing and nuclear translocation machinery (SCAP/INSIG) to mediate sterol-depletion feedback.
Baseline cholesterol synthesis activity sufficient to show relief of feedback inhibition.
HMGCR expression and enzymatic activity that can be inhibited by a statin.
falsifiers: No coordinated up-regulation of the sterol biosynthesis gene set (e.g., HMGCS1, INSIG1, FDFT1, SQLE, MVD, MVK, PMVK, IDI1, LSS, DHCR7, EBP, NSDHL, SC5D, CYP51A1, ACAT2) at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines.
HMGCR mRNA is not reduced at 24 h despite expected feedback and possible statin-mediated effects.
A strong generic stress or proliferation signature dominates without the specific sterol-synthesis feedback response.
